verses.text: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to You, O LORD.
verses.textZh: （上行之詩。）耶和華啊，我從深處向你求告！

verses.text: Lord, hear my voice! Let Your ears be attentive To the voice of my supplications.
verses.textZh: 主啊，求你聽我的聲音！願你側耳聽我懇求的聲音！

verses.text: If You, LORD, should mark iniquities, O Lord, who could stand?
verses.textZh: 主─耶和華啊，你若究察罪孽，誰能站得住呢？

verses.text: But there is forgiveness with You, That You may be feared.
verses.textZh: 但在你有赦免之恩，要叫人敬畏你。

verses.text: I wait for the LORD, my soul does wait, And in His word do I hope.
verses.textZh: 我等候耶和華，我的心等候；我也仰望他的話。

verses.text: My soul [waits] for the Lord More than the watchmen for the morning; [Indeed, more than] the watchmen for the morning.
verses.textZh: 我的心等候主，勝於守夜的，等候天亮，勝於守夜的，等候天亮。

verses.text: O Israel, hope in the LORD; For with the LORD there is lovingkindness, And with Him is abundant redemption.
verses.textZh: 以色列啊，你當仰望耶和華！因他有慈愛，有豐盛的救恩。

verses.text: And He will redeem Israel From all his iniquities.
verses.textZh: 他必救贖以色列脫離一切的罪孽。
